reason: 3 application defect(s) reproduced by the evaluator: the AUT does not satisfy AC-2, AC-3, AC-7. Awaiting reviewer confirmation.

aut.name: Swag Labs (saucedemo.com demo shop)
aut.notes: UI only. Public demo credentials are shown on its login page.

applicationDefects.title: Sales tax charged at 8% instead of the 10% in pricing-rules.md
applicationDefects.rationale: Item total ($39.98 = $29.99 + $9.99) and Total = Item total + Tax both hold, isolating the fault to the tax rate: $3.20 is 8.0% of $39.98, while pricing-rules.md (attached to the story, owned by Finance) requires 10% → $4.00. Money is computed wrongly on every order. (Confirmed in run 03-rerun; identical failure signature in 04-regression.)
applicationDefects.liveCheck: Reproduced live on 2026-09-26 (tier 3) with the first two catalogue products: 'Item total: $39.98', 'Tax: $3.20', 'Total: $43.18' — see runs/02-eval/confirm/SCN-010.png
steps: Given I am on the sign-in page
Given I am signed in as the "standard" shopper
And I have added the 1st and 2nd listed products to the cart, noting their prices
When I open the cart and proceed to checkout
And I continue with my First Name, Last Name and Postal Code
Then the Item total equals the sum of the noted prices
And the Tax equals 10% of the Item total rounded half-up to 2 decimals
And the Total equals the Item total plus the Tax

applicationDefects.title: Credential fields are not cleared after a failed sign-in
applicationDefects.rationale: Both textboxes are located; after the wrong-password error is displayed they still contain the typed username and password. AC-3 requires both to be cleared for security. The error message part of AC-3 passes (SCN-003), so the fault is isolated to field clearing. (Confirmed in run 03-rerun; identical failure signature in 04-regression.)
applicationDefects.liveCheck: Reproduced live on 2026-09-26 (tier 3): after the error, Username='standard_user' and Password='wrong_password' remain — see runs/02-eval/confirm/SCN-004.png
steps: Given I am on the sign-in page
When I sign in as the "standard" shopper with the password "wrong_password"
Then the Username field is empty
And the Password field is empty

applicationDefects.title: Locked-account error message does not match the required wording
applicationDefects.expected: "Your account has been locked. Please contact customer support."
applicationDefects.actual: "Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out."
applicationDefects.rationale: The alert is located and visible, the shopper correctly stays on the sign-in page (that part of AC-2 passes), but the message text differs from the verbatim wording AC-2 mandates. Behaviour (blocking the locked account) is correct; the communicated message is not. (Confirmed in run 03-rerun; identical failure signature in 04-regression.)
applicationDefects.liveCheck: Reproduced live on 2026-09-26 (tier 3): signing in as locked_out_user shows the alert 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.' — see runs/02-eval/confirm/SCN-002.png
steps: Given I am on the sign-in page
When I sign in as the "locked" shopper
Then I see the error "Your account has been locked. Please contact customer support."
And I am still on the sign-in page

scriptDefectsRepaired.action: Restored the verified locator getByRole('button', { name: 'Checkout' }) via the shared openCartAndCheckout() helper; probe count=1; integrity re-checked (PRESERVED).

scenarios.title: Locked shopper cannot sign in and is told the account is locked

Wrong password clears the credential fields for security

Removing products decreases the cart badge and hides it when empty

traceability.text: Finishing the order shows the confirmation "Thank you for your order!" and the cart is empty afterwards.

scenarios.title: Finishing the order confirms it and empties the cart
